about_the_game:
Action and Strategy

A real-time strategy (RTS) game that fuses MOBA and RPG elements, keeping the action nonstop.

Here, your soldiers are key to economic growth: you must conquer territories to gain resources and strengthen your army.

Every choice in combat and expansion directly affects your progress and your faction’s survival.

Build with your soldiers

In this game, your soldiers aren’t just fighters. They can also be used to build defensive towers, gold mines, and fortresses.

Unlike traditional RTS titles—where only specialized units handle construction—here any soldier can fill that role, letting you deploy more flexible and dynamic strategies.

With this system, you can quickly establish forward outposts, gather resources, and bolster your army in unexpected spots, keeping enemies on constant alert and giving yourself more ways to outmaneuver them.

The Loan

Need a quick boost? The loan system gives you extra resources right when you need them, powering your expansion and military might. But beware: every loan carries interest you’ll have to settle later. Will you turn debt into victory, or end up trapped by the interest?

Play Online

Enjoy intense online battles where you can invite friends or face players from around the globe. Online mode lets you form teams, craft strategies together, or challenge unknown rivals, testing your tactical skills in every match.
